title: Using AI to run one game's engine inside another: Skate 3's skating in Valheim (free mod)
author: JollyMight364
selftext:
Skateheim is a Valheim mod I built with Claude. Press J and your character switches to Skate 3's actual skating engine (chasm's 2010 Rust Rewrite Mashup), riding on Valheim's terrain, rocks, trees and player builds. Press J again and you're back in Valheim where you stopped.



Some of the interesting problems:

\- Collision: Valheim's world is handed to the Skate 3 engine, so you can grind and ollie off things players built.

\- Sound: nothing from Skate 3 ships with the mod. On first launch it decodes about 130 sounds from the player's own copy of the game. Rolling is granular, picking grains from Skate 3's speed-up recordings to match your speed, so it never loops.

\- Mixing: the sounds play dry (Valheim's reverb made them sound washed out) but still follow Valheim's sound-effects volume slider.

\- Board swings hit Valheim creatures, never players or tames.



It installs in one click through Melty: [https://melty.gg/m/skateheim](https://melty.gg/m/skateheim) (needs Valheim on PC and your own copy of Skate 3). Unofficial fan mod.



Feedback welcome, especially on how the skating feels.

comments.body: Lowkey tired of seeing these. Stupid and waste of time/resources.

comments.author: MrBrightside711
comments.body: I called it last week in the first game mashup post. This type of content is slop. Having AI mash together existing games doesn't make you a game dev. Either post this in the subs of the AI that made it, or the games it's mashing, but it doesn't belong here. No one cares what games you like. And that's all this is... It's just showing people what AI did with games you like.
